stem.text: The diameter of a solid metal sphere is measured using a micrometer screw gauge. The diagram shows an enlargement of the shaft of the micrometer screw gauge when taking the measurement.

stem.alt: Enlarged shaft of a micrometer screw gauge, with the printed numbers 3 and 4 on the scale along the shaft and 20, 30 and 40 on the scale beside the rotating part.

stem.text: The mass of the sphere is $0.450\,\text{g}$.
